component.name: scale_tail
component.summary: System tray control centre for Tailscale

description.p: scale_tail is a small system tray app that wraps the Tailscale command line client, so you can manage your tailnet connection without opening a terminal.
From the tray menu you can:

ul.li: Choose or clear an exit node
Browse peers, copy their addresses, ping them and send files
Switch accounts and toggle common Tailscale settings
Start on login and auto-connect on launch
Open the login page when Tailscale needs authentication

description.p: It requires the tailscale command to be installed and the tailscaled service to be running.

ul.li: uQ quick-settings tile: on/off switch, current exit node and an exit-node picker
uQ Settings Tailscale page: connection, account, exit node, routes, local-network access and devices
scale_tail status --json prints a summary of Tailscale's state for scripts
The tray is not started under uQ; scale_tail --tray starts it anyway
Tailscale is polled less often and the tray stays responsive while actions run
Arch Linux PKGBUILD that also installs the uQ integration
Update hints and metadata are launcher-agnostic; added X-AppImage-Version and --version
Update checker: notifies when a new GitHub release is available
AppImage update information embedded for AppImage launchers and updaters
Settings submenu, start on login, auto-connect on launch
Account switching, ping, send files, suggested exit node
